evaluation.title: Retrieval evaluation report
evaluation.localOnlyTitle: The report is read in this browser only; nothing is uploaded or saved
evaluation.localOnlyDescription: Choose the report JSON produced by the evaluation tool (at most 2 MB), not raw predictions or business data. This shows a recorded report, not the current service state; offline results do not reflect real model or OCR quality either.

errors.invalid: The report format or statistics are inconsistent. Choose a schemaVersion=1 report JSON produced by the evaluation tool, not a raw prediction file.
errors.invalidLive: The comparison report format or statistics are inconsistent. Choose a complete schemaVersion=1 report produced by live_compare.
errors.invalidJson: The file is not valid JSON. Choose a report produced by the evaluation tool.
errors.invalidFile: Choose a non-empty JSON report of at most 2 MB.
errors.readFailed: The report could not be read. Choose the file again.

evaluation.scoreNoteTitle: Scores count source documents; they do not replace chunk accuracy or real business acceptance.
evaluation.scoreNote: Recall with real models, OCR, complex tables and actual documents needs separate verification. Metrics not in the gate list have no threshold; a passing report does not mean they are met.

live.mode: Paired dense / hybrid comparison with real models
live.noteTitle: A source-level comparison on synthetic samples; not acceptance of real business or the current service.
live.note: The report calls the Python retrieval implementation directly; timings exclude Java HTTP/RPC and network overhead. OCR, answer correctness and faithfulness were not evaluated; a single run does not show a statistically significant improvement or a load test. Overall acceptance follows the checks already in the report; no thresholds were added.
